Bill.BriefDescription: Reducing workplace violence in state hospitals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reducing workplace violence in state hospitals;and adding a new section to chapter 72.23 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By September 1st of each year, the department shall report to thehouse committee on commerce and labor and the senate committee oncommerce and trade, or successor committees, on the department'sefforts to reduce violence in the state hospitals.
